messages.subject: Error while downloading data from Jefferis lab website (flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk)
parts:
Hi Jefferis lab :)

I am encountering a problem when trying to download data (flycircuit or gmr) from the lab website:
flycircuit:
> dps<-read.neuronlistfh("http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/dpscanon.rds",
+                        localdir=getOption('flycircuit.datadir'))
> remotesync(dps,download.missing = TRUE)
trying URL 'http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/dpscanon.rds'
Content type 'application/octet-stream' length 4727220 bytes (4.5 MB)
==================================================
downloaded 4.5 MB

Downloading 15474 missing neurons from http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/data/
  649/15474 [====>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------]  eta:  3hError in download.file(url = paste0(attr(fh, "remote"), missing[i]), destfile = file.path(objDir,  : 
  download from 'http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/data/46e4802593fb178616c6837bcb78727b' failed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In download.file(url = paste0(attr(fh, "remote"), missing[i]), destfile = file.path(objDir,  :
  downloaded length 111704 != reported length 112366
2: In download.file(url = paste0(attr(fh, "remote"), missing[i]), destfile = file.path(objDir,  :
  URL 'http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/data/46e4802593fb178616c6837bcb78727b': status was 'Failure when receiving data from the peer'
gmr:
> gmrdps<-read.neuronlistfh("http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/gmrdps.rds",
+                           localdir=getOption('flycircuit.datadir'))
> remotesync(gmrdps,download.missing = TRUE)
trying URL 'http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/gmrdps.rds'
Content type 'application/octet-stream' length 237859 bytes (232 KB)
==================================================
downloaded 232 KB

Downloading 1809 missing neurons from http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/data/
  6/1809 [----------------------------------------------]  eta: 41mError in download.file(url = paste0(attr(fh, "remote"), missing[i]), destfile = file.path(objDir,  : 
  download from 'http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/data/a0abfb8e3572705d4bd25c370f8f3e82' failed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In download.file(url = paste0(attr(fh, "remote"), missing[i]), destfile = file.path(objDir,  :
  downloaded length 109761 != reported length 110640
2: In download.file(url = paste0(attr(fh, "remote"), missing[i]), destfile = file.path(objDir,  :
  URL 'http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/data/a0abfb8e3572705d4bd25c370f8f3e82': status was 'Failure when receiving data from the peer'

Not sure if I might have something set incorrectly, so apologies if that's the case!

Best,
Asa Barth-Maron
